queries.constant_false_bare: WITH false AS p WHERE NOT NOT p RETURN p
queries.constant_false_control: WITH false AS p WHERE NOT (NOT p) RETURN p
queries.constant_true_bare: WITH true AS p WHERE NOT NOT p RETURN p
queries.constant_true_control: WITH true AS p WHERE NOT (NOT p) RETURN p
queries.double_not_bare: MATCH (n:BoolCase) WHERE NOT NOT n.flag RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
queries.double_not_fully_parenthesized: MATCH (n:BoolCase) WHERE NOT (NOT (n.flag)) RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
queries.double_not_working_control: MATCH (n:BoolCase) WHERE NOT (NOT n.flag) RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
queries.original: MATCH (n:BoolCase) WHERE n.flag RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
queries.projection_context: MATCH (n:BoolCase) RETURN n.id AS id, n.flag AS flag, NOT NOT n.flag AS bare, NOT (NOT n.flag) AS parenthesized, NOT (NOT (n.flag)) AS fully_parenthesized ORDER BY id
queries.single_not: MATCH (n:BoolCase) WHERE NOT n.flag RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
